evidence.title: Australian social media users offered choice to opt out of algorithms

occurrences.checkable_against: Australian government announcement and proposed Digital Duty of Care legislation
occurrences.quote_span: Australian social media users would be given a choice to opt out of algorithms under proposed laws announced by the government Tuesday that would let users have more control over what they see on their social media feeds.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Australian government social media algorithm rules

occurrences.checkable_against: Australian government statement on proposed Digital Duty of Care legislation
occurrences.quote_span: Digital services including online games, apps and artificial intelligence chatbots would also be required to protect children from design features that have negative behavioral impacts such as addictive features and those that have an effect on self-esteem, the statement said.
occurrences.speaker: Australian government
occurrences.subject: Australian government social media algorithm rules

occurrences.checkable_against: Proposed Australian Digital Duty of Care legislation penalty provisions
occurrences.quote_span: Penalties under the proposed Digital Duty of Care legislation could be as high as 109.2 million Australian dollars ($78.6 million).

occurrences.subject: Australian government social media algorithm rules

occurrences.checkable_against: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's remarks and proposed Digital Duty of Care legislation
occurrences.quote_span: “It gives users choice and it will hold the big tech companies responsible for inaction. If they don’t follow our laws, they will face significant penalties,” Albanese added.
occurrences.speaker: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese
occurrences.subject: Australian government social media algorithm rules

occurrences.checkable_against: Australian government statement on proposed Digital Duty of Care legislation
occurrences.quote_span: Social media platforms would be required to send a notification to new and existing users offering them a choice over their default feed, a government statement said.
occurrences.speaker: Australian government
occurrences.subject: Australian government social media algorithm rules

occurrences.checkable_against: Proposed Australian Digital Duty of Care legislation
occurrences.quote_span: The proposed legislation would also protect children from content that promotes eating disorders, hostile ideas about women, pornography, crime, dangerous stunts and that causes serious mental health distress.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Australian government social media algorithm rules

occurrences.checkable_against: Proposed Australian Digital Duty of Care legislation and government implementation rules
occurrences.quote_span: Users would be able to opt in to having their default feed include personalized content recommended by an algorithm. Alternatively, users could see the content of friends and creators they choose to follow.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Australian government social media algorithm rules

occurrences.checkable_against: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's Canberra remarks and proposed legislation
occurrences.quote_span: “We’ll require social media platforms to provide user empowerment tools that give people over the age of 16 genuine and enduring choice about what they see in their feeds,” Prime Minister Anthony Albanese told reporters in Canberra.
occurrences.speaker: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese
occurrences.subject: Australian government social media algorithm rules
